programme.title: The Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live

programme.title: George Thorogood & The Destroyers: Live at Montreux 2013
programme.desc: In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, Thorogood and his band have released 16 albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Irma La Douce
programme.desc: Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Peter Ustinov won an Oscar for Best Supporting Actor in this lighthearted thriller about five thieves (including Melina Mercouri, Maximilian Schell, and Robert Morley) who undertake an absolutely impossible grand theft in Istanbul.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the own is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Alma & the Wolf
programme.desc: After a violent animal attack, paranoia spreads through Spiral Creek. But when Deputy Ren Accord gets too close, his son vanishes, and reality begins to fracture.

programme.title: Green Room
programme.desc: After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A richly layered ode to the generations of people and places that shape us in a lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a woman's life in Mississippi. The haunting feature debut from award-winning artist Raven Jackson.

programme.title: Earth Mama
programme.desc: With two children in foster care, Gia, a pregnant single mother pitted against the system, fights to reclaim her family. In her close-knit Bay Area community, she works to make a life for herself and her kids.

programme.title: A Game of Death
programme.desc: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: A Bruce Lee Classic! Lee plays Chen Zhen, a student of Huo Yuanjia, who fights to defend the honor of the Chinese in the face of foreign aggression, and to bring to justice those responsible for his master's death.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell star in director Harold Ramis' brilliant comedy about a man who clones himself to save his marriage, and then almost loses his wife to himself! Keaton takes on four hilariously distinct roles.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: A mysterious pill that enables the user to access 100% of his brain's abilities transforms a struggling writer into a financial wizard, but it also puts him in a new world with many dangers.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island and finds out some places never let you go.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embark on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly fool-proof plan soon proves to be useless when an unexpected witness interferes, as the plan quickly unravels.

programme.title: The Farewell
programme.desc: In this funny, heartfelt story, Billi's (Awkwafina) family returns to China under the guise of a fake wedding to stealthily say goodbye to their beloved matriarch—the only person that doesn't know she only has a few weeks to live.

programme.title: The Boy In The Striped Pajamas
programme.desc: A forbidden friendship forms between Bruno, the son of a Nazi commandant, and Schmuel, a Jewish boy held captive in a concentration camp. Though separated physically by a barbed wire fence, their lives become inescapably intertwined.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Nora & Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrest apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Decades later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as a host of stars, including Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick, have their eyes set on a shipment of whiskey and let loose in this wild comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover many of the fantastic characters, and thrilling situations, found in their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling series of books comes a fantasy adventure, revealing the unseen world that exists all around us.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon that aspires to be a swashbuckling hero finds himself in a Western town plagued by bandits and is forced to literally play the role in order to protect it.

programme.title: The 4:30 Movie
programme.desc: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Doc's obnoxious new girlfriend, Stacy, makes Chris' life a living hell, Chris decides it's about time he split up the happy couple. Meanwhile, Tonya starts wearing a bra to get the attention of the boys in her class.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Although he is supposed to be home watching Drew and Tonya, Chris sneaks out to go to the movies with his friends and witnesses a shoot-out outside the theater.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is just starting to fit in at his new high school when he gets asked on a date by the dorkiest girl in school, Kelly, whom everyone calls 'Big Bird.'

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Julius realizes that the key to keeping Rochelle happy in their marriage is getting advice from 'The Oprah Winfrey Show.' Unfortunately, the plan backfires when Rochelle equates Julius' new attitude with an extramarital affair.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: On a gay cruise, Victoria and Joy continue the charade that they are married, while Melanie runs into her sister and her girlfriend.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: When the dry cleaners misdeliver her favorite dress to a woman who then dies, Melanie crashes the funeral with Victoria, Joy and Elka to retrieve it undetected.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Melanie, Victoria and Joy put their Midwestern neighbors on an L.A. weight-loss regimen, while Elka lies about her age to keep up with spontaneous thrill-seeker Roy.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Victoria dates a hand model, Roy's mother dislikes Elka, Joy can't figure out the age of the guy she's seeing, and Melanie's boyfriend resembles Winnie-the-Pooh.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Waiting to use the women's restroom at a Browns game, Melanie, Victoria and Joy recount to Elka how they all originally met on a Beverly Hill's hotel rooftop in the 80s.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Major League

programme.title: The Tuxedo

programme.title: Point Break

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Todos hemos hecho algo ridículo por dinero, a veces para costear la cita con el chico de tus sueños y otras simplemente para sobrevivir otro día como adulto. Hoy te traemos seis sketches para que te rías de los gajes del oficio. Dale play al episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: La vida se define por los momentos en los que hiciste realidad lo que parecía imposible. Como lograr que te den la visa gringa. Te traemos seis sketches para rememorar estos momentos de gloria. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¡Trágame tierra! Este episodio está dedicado a los momentos vergonzosos de los que ni tú te libras. No sufras y mejor ríe con estos cinco sketches que traemos para ti. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Crecer es peor que estornudar en tu periodo. De niño seguramente soñabas con crecer, pero para tu sorpresa, ahora solo sales al trabajo y al banco. En este episodio te traemos 6 sketches para que te desquites de las penas de la vida adulta. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si los superhéroes hubieran sido creados en Latinoamérica, tendrían verdaderos talentos como bajarse del bus al vuelo, esquivar chanclas de mamá y un sueño profundo inmune al camión de la chatarra. Dale play a este nuevo episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Tal vez es momento de admitir que sí le robaste a tu mamá 5 dólares para comprarte una salchipapa, o que esas revistas inapropiadas que encontraron en tu casillero sí son tuyas. Tranquilo, no eres el único con secretos que contar. Dale play al episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Imagina tener control z en una película de terror. Los protagonistas pagarían la luz a tiempo y no abrirían la puerta donde está el asesino, pero entonces no habría película. Disfruta estos sketches de miedo para que te mueras de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Existen situaciones peores que la muerte. Como andar de fiesta y descubrir 20 llamadas perdidas de tu mamá. Mira el episodio de hoy y disfruta con estas situaciones para morir de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Contrario a lo que muchos piensan, la vida sí es como en las películas. Pero una película de bajo presupuesto. Dale play al episodio y se le estrella de tu propio película... bueno el extra del fondo.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Mientras todos están exhaustos por los experimentos de Ouga, un sujeto de prueba habla de sus objetivos, lo que hace que todos los demás hablen sobre lo que quieren hacer si sobreviven.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Mientras Boruto y los demás son forzados a participar en los experimentos de Ouga, Sarada y su equipo investigan la desaparición de Boruto y descubren de la existencia de un individuo sospechoso.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Sasuke fue atacado por Meno, el guardian del Observatorio, y lo envenenó.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Sasuke y Sakura trabajan juntos para reunir información acerca de las Ultra Partículas.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Una gran cantidad de Bestias Dragón de pronto aparecen en el Observatorio, causadando caos.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Code adora a Isshiki Otsutsuki, que fue derrotado por Boruto y sus amigos. Para poder conocer a cierta persona, visita una propiedad que le pertenecía a Boro.

programme.title: Heidi: La renuncia
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier regresa y se da cuenta que Heidi tiene a una cabra bebé. Heidi decide irse a vivir con Rudy y tomar un tren para regresar a las montañas. Rottemeier le da una segunda oportunidad a Heidi.

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio
programme.desc: Clara ya puede ponerse de pie sin ayuda de nadie. El señor Sesemann quiere adoptar a Heidi, Heidi se aterra de la situación pensando que ya nunca vovler a las montañas. El señor Sesseman entiende el miedo de Heidi y decide posponer la adopción.

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma
programme.desc: Heidi no puede dormir, extraña su vida en las montañas. Todos en la casa piensan que se trata de un fantasma pero en realidad es Heidi que extraña su vida anterior. Clara invita al abuelo a pasar unos días en Frankfurt.

programme.title: Heidi: La carta
programme.desc: Heidi se enferma al enterarse de que su tía nunca le mando la carta al abuelo, Clara está angustiada y pide que dejen a Heidi regresar a las montañas. Finalmente Heidi irá de regreso y mandan la carta pero la carta se pierde en el camino.

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli
programme.desc: Heidi toma el tren de vuelta a las montañas, el abuelo no recibe la carta y emprende un viaje a Mayenfeld, Heidi hará todo lo posible para llegar con su abuelo y pedirle que regrese a las montañas.

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño
programme.desc: Heidi esta feliz de regresar de nuevo a la montaña con Pedro y las cabras. Karl se mete en un problema y Pedro tiene que acudir a su rescate, Heidi se queda sola con las cabras con la sorpresa de que la cabra embarazada esta a punto de dar a luz.

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota
programme.desc: Heidi y el abuelo se mudan a la mansión para que Heidi pueda continuar sus estudios. Los Keller se enojan por esta situación y se niegan a venderle suministros al abuelo.

programme.title: Heidi: El prendedor
programme.desc: Pedro y su abuela no tienen suficiente dinero, Heidi encuentra el broche de su abuela, una reliquia que los puede ayudar a salir de este problema.

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar
programme.desc: El profesor organizar una prueba para finalizar el periodo, Theresa esta celosa de que Heidi esta ayudando a Pedro a ser buen estudiante, en venganza abre el recinto de las cabras para que Pedro no pueda llegar a la prueba a tiempo.

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro
programme.desc: El Sr Traber se mudará a otra ciudad pero se lleva consigo a Karl, Theresa tiene sentimientos por él. Heidi la empujara a que confiese sus sentimientos por el antes de que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: La hora de las cabras
programme.desc: Por fin llega Clara y la señorita Rottenmeier a visitar a Heidi, Clara y Heidi quieren pasar el mayor tiempo juntas por lo que deben convencer a la señorita Rottenmeier de que vivan juntos en las cabañas en la montaña.
